name: AdminLayout
description: An application shell with a collapsible sidebar, a header, and a mobile drawer. State lives in attributes on the root rather than a slot scope, so both adapters render it and one controller flips it.

id.description: Names the sidebar; the mobile toggle points at it with aria-controls.

default.description: Page content, rendered inside the main landmark.

brand.description: Product identity at the top of the sidebar.

header.description: Header content beside the mobile toggle.

mobileBrand.description: Product identity shown in the header on narrow screens.
